title: CLI shell tools inherit shared Hub startup environment instead of launching client
body:
Cline CLI 3.0.73 on macOS reuses an existing local Hub. A shell tool invoked by the model then sees the terminal context from whichever client started that Hub.

## Reproduction

1. Launch Cline in terminal A and leave its Hub running.
2. In terminal B export a fresh non-secret canary, launch the interactive CLI, and ask it to run a shell probe comparing that canary and terminal identifiers with terminal B.
3. Compare only presence/equality; do not print credentials or a complete environment.

## Observed

A real model-invoked Python child ran under the pre-existing Hub. Terminal pane/tab/workspace identifiers differed from the new launching shell, TERM_PROGRAM was absent, and five fresh synthetic environment canaries were absent. The expectation was captured from terminal B before launching its TUI; this did not independently capture the TUI process environment.

## Expected

Shell commands receive session-scoped launch context. Two clients sharing the Hub must not inherit each other’s terminal identifiers, and no request may mutate the Hub’s global environment.

## Source diagnosis

Reproduced release: cli-v3.0.73. Confirmed in main dab482348ffd83d1065dfcf8b538076608925a79: HubRuntimeHost.startSession sends no shell environment in session.create; handleSessionCreate starts a Hub-local runtime; the built-in shell executor spawns with a merge of process.env and executor overrides. The daemon therefore supplies its startup environment to later sessions. The released shell executor has the same merge.

Related but different: [the hook lifecycle issue](https://github.com/cline/cline/issues/14961) and [its related PR](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15012) concern TaskStart/TaskResume selection from daemon environment. Refreshed issues and PR searches found no exact shell-environment duplicate.

## Scope

No existing Hub was restarted. An isolated data directory reached authentication onboarding, so no isolated authenticated model comparison is claimed.
